June 10, 2018 - By Ellis Scott
Forte Capital Llc increased its stake in Merck & Co Inc (MRK) by 31.91% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Forte Capital Llc bought 7,595 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.40% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 31,397 shares of the health care company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.71 million, up from 23,802 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Forte Capital Llc who had been investing in Merck & Co Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $168.36B market cap company. The stock increased 0.95% or $0.59 during the last trading session, reaching $62.58. About 9.68 million shares traded. Merck & Co., Inc. (NYSE:MRK) has declined 9.15% since June 10, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 21.72% the S&P500.
